purpose: Final A2-only outcome-blind linkage augmentation. If the preregistered efficacy N gate remains unreachable, stop weakening A2 identity rules and pivot to a separately frozen second cohort.
uniformity_rule: Apply to every V0.3 unresolved record; prediction labels/statuses are never loaded.
candidate_generation: Q5 human with exact day-precision P569 equal to frozen A2 birth date.

place_evidence.VERY_STRONG: P19 coordinate within 20 km of frozen A2 coordinates
place_evidence.STRONG: P19 normalized place-name match OR coordinate within 50 km

name_evidence.2: A2 surname exactly matches candidate edge token
name_evidence.1: at least two A2 name tokens each edit-distance <=1 to distinct candidate tokens

resolution: Require place_strength>=1 and name_strength>=1. Rank by place_strength then name_strength, unique top only. Existing V0.3 links immutable.
stop_rule: No A2 v0.5 with weaker identity evidence if V0.4 remains below the pre-unblind N target.
